scope: Save/load lot 14: whole-world certification on the retail data. No original code was imported; the references below explain the one original loss the certification found and kept.

references.purpose: CInventoryMgr::Update (2701-2711) shows the current weapon's hand model only while the owner is updated; DropCurrentWeapon (1125-1149) returns CHWEAP_NOTAVAIL silently when the weapon is not in the hand; Load (2929-2954) recreates weapons with ObtainWeapon and no hand model.
CWeapon::ShowHandModel (358-389): the hand model is created on demand and removed on hide; nothing saves it.
